name: i9_10_topfloor_defense_required
note: D487 through the stock Top Floor window: a fresh player who owns none of the D511 preset girls (so no preset defense is written) opens the arena, preflights an offered opponent (294), enters the stock formation window, selects the team and confirms START (280) without ever saving a defense. The server refuses before any ticket debit, so no battle window opens, the formation window stays, and a stock LOAD_ARENA read afterwards still reports 5 tickets.
steps: lua:local cards = {} local function walk(node) if not node:isVisible() then return end if node:getName() == 'layout' then table.insert(cards, node) return end for _, child in ipairs(node:getChildren()) do walk(child) end end walk(xyd.WindowManager.get():getWindow('arena_select_team'):nodeByName('list_layer')) for _, card in ipairs(cards) do local box = card:getCascadeBoundingBox() __vc.tap(box.x + box.width / 2, box.y + box.height / 2) end

lua:local w=xyd.WindowManager.get() assert(w:getWindow('arena_select_team'),'vc-defense-refusal-window-gone') assert(not w:getWindow('battle_win') and not w:getWindow('battle_lose'),'vc-defense-refusal-entered-battle') print('vc-defense-refusal-ok')
